The case was jointly investigated by the Penghu District Public Prosecutor's Office Zhongshu Lin Jiyin, who commanded the Penghu Detection and Defense Branch of the Coast Guard Branch and the Seventh Shore Patrol of the Golden Horse Pen Branch.
